notes:
Scope clarification 2026-05-11 (Mark): per the PKIX-amgn.2 scope-X decision, the actual move of CA/B Forum content out of `pkix-profiles` into `pkix-profiles-cabf` happens HERE in .4, not in .2 (which is empty-skeleton only).

Move list (explicit, includes CodeSigningProfile which was missing from the original amgn epic body):

- `WebPkiProfile` (currently named in code; bead prose refers to it as `TlsBrProfile`)
- `SmimeProfile`
- `CodeSigningProfile` ← added per Mark 2026-05-11
- `CABF_TLS_BR_ALLOWED_ALGS`, `CABF_SMIME_BR_ALLOWED_ALGS`, `CABF_CS_BR_ALLOWED_ALGS` tables
- Their corresponding `_policy()` free functions
- SC-081 helpers (validity cap math, etc.)
- Their tests

Deprecation shim plan: keep `pub use pkix_profiles_cabf::{WebPkiProfile, SmimeProfile, CodeSigningProfile, ...}` re-exports in `pkix-profiles` for one minor version, marked `#[deprecated = "moved to pkix-profiles-cabf"]`. Drop the re-exports in the next major bump.

Renaming question (WebPkiProfile → TlsBrProfile to match bead prose): leave as a follow-up; consistent rename can happen during the deprecation period in pkix-profiles-cabf without affecting the move itself.

This bead also adds BasicSmime/BasicTls to what's LEFT in pkix-profiles after the move — that part of .4's original description is unchanged.
title: Refactor pkix-profiles: strip CA/B Forum content, add BasicSmimeProfile (RFC 8551) and BasicTlsProfile (RFC 5280 + RFC 6125 + serverAuth EKU)
